title: Advanced NPCs: sprites.json
description: One sprite set (ANPCs/<id>/sprites or sprites_<n>). Each animation is <name>.png: frames left to right, the 8 directions top to bottom.

cellHeight.description: Height in pixels of one frame cell.

groundY.description: Pixel row of the feet, from the cell's bottom.

standingHeight.description: Standing body height in pixels above groundY, without held weapons (default: measured from the idle sheets).

directions.description: Informational: rows are always in this order.

animations.description: Standard state names include idle, walk, run, hit, attack, attack_range, cast, heal, greet, talk and death. Custom names such as pray_1 or eat_2 load when referenced by a play_animation package. Projectiles are images a ranged attack flies.

actionFrame.description: Attack sheets: the frame (1-based) the blow lands on.

stepFrames.description: Walk and run sheets: the frames (1-based) a footstep sound plays on (default: the first and the middle frame).

cellHeight.description: Projectiles: cell height in pixels (default: the image height, one row).

pixelsPerUnit.description: Projectiles: their own scale (default: the set's).

fps.description: Projectiles: their own frame rate (default: the set's).
